name: workspace_records
query: create table if not exists public.studio_workspace_records (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), actor_email text not null, record_type text not null check (record_type in ('task','message','client','schedule','invoice','upload','equipment','channel')), payload jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists studio_workspace_records_actor_type_idx on public.studio_workspace_records(actor_email, record_type); alter table public.studio_workspace_records enable row level security; drop policy if exists "workspace records self read" on public.studio_workspace_records; drop policy if exists "workspace records self write" on public.studio_workspace_records; create policy "workspace records self read" on public.studio_workspace_records for select using ((auth.jwt() ->> 'email') = actor_email); create policy "workspace records self write" on public.studio_workspace_records for all using ((auth.jwt() ->> 'email') = actor_email) with check ((auth.jwt() ->> 'email') = actor_email);
